import json, sys, zlib

def solve(request):
    pages = [bytearray(bytes.fromhex(p)) for p in request["pages"]]
    checkpoint = request["checkpoint"]
    log = bytes.fromhex(request["log"]) if request["log"] else b""
    
    n = len(log)
    pos = 0
    prev_seq = 0
    last_seq = 0
    active = {}  # txid -> [count, crc, patches list]
    
    while True:
        if n - pos < 13:
            break
        header = log[pos:pos+13]
        plen = int.from_bytes(header[0:4], "little")
        seq = int.from_bytes(header[4:8], "little")
        kind = header[8]
        txid = int.from_bytes(header[9:13], "little")
        if plen > 4096:
            break
        end = pos + 13 + plen + 4
        if end > n:
            break
        payload = log[pos+13:pos+13+plen]
        crc_stored = int.from_bytes(log[pos+13+plen:end], "little")
        if zlib.crc32(log[pos:pos+13+plen]) & 0xffffffff != crc_stored:
            break
        if seq == 0 or seq <= prev_seq:
            break
        if txid == 0:
            break
        # kind + payload shape
        if kind == 1:  # BEGIN
            if plen != 0: break
        elif kind == 2:  # PATCH
            if plen < 6: break
            page_index = int.from_bytes(payload[0:2], "little")
            offset = int.from_bytes(payload[2:4], "little")
            count = int.from_bytes(payload[4:6], "little")
            if count == 0 or plen != 6 + count: break
            if page_index >= len(pages): break
            if offset + count > len(pages[page_index]): break
        elif kind == 3:  # COMMIT
            if plen != 8: break
        elif kind == 4:  # ABORT
            if plen != 0: break
        else:
            break
        
        # structurally valid; semantic effect
        if kind == 1:
            active[txid] = [0, 0, []]
        elif kind == 2:
            inc = active.get(txid)
            if inc is not None:
                inc[0] += 1
                inc[1] = zlib.crc32(payload, inc[1]) & 0xffffffff
                inc[2].append((page_index, offset, payload[6:]))
        elif kind == 4:
            active.pop(txid, None)
        elif kind == 3:
            inc = active.pop(txid, None)
            if inc is not None:
                want_count = int.from_bytes(payload[0:4], "little")
                want_digest = int.from_bytes(payload[4:8], "little")
                if inc[0] == want_count and inc[1] == want_digest and seq > checkpoint:
                    for pi, off, data in inc[2]:
                        pages[pi][off:off+len(data)] = data
        
        prev_seq = seq
        last_seq = seq
        pos = end
    
    return {
        "pages": [p.hex() for p in pages],
        "valid_bytes": pos,
        "last_seq": last_seq,
    }

if __name__ == "__main__":
    out = sys.stdout
    for line in sys.stdin:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:

        out.write(json.dumps(solve(json.loads(line))) + "\n")
        out.flush()

def abort(seq, txid): return rec(seq, 4, txid, b"")

def digest_of(payloads):
    c = 0
    for p in payloads:
        c = zlib.crc32(p, c)

CRC_LEN = 4
MAX_PAYLOAD = 4096

KIND_PATCH = 2
KIND_COMMIT = 3
KIND_ABORT = 4

    last_seq = 0     # sequence of the last valid record (0 for empty prefix)
